chain.label: Colgan lacked airspeed selection/ref speeds switch cross-check procedures
chain.trigger: Colgan Air's inadequate procedures for airspeed selection and management during approaches in icing conditions

chain.label: Both pilots fatigued after poor-quality crew-room and in-transit sleep
chain.trigger: the pilots' performance was likely impaired because of fatigue... interrupted and poor-quality sleep during the 24 hours before the accident

chain.label: Night conditions with light snow and mist on approach
chain.trigger: Night visual meteorological conditions prevailed... the night and poor visibility conditions at the time precluded the use of external visual cues for reliable attitude reference

chain.label: Airplane accumulated ice during descent into Buffalo
chain.trigger: the first officer responded, 'lots of ice'... an 'ice detected' message appeared on the engine display

chain.label: Crew set ref speeds switch to INCR but did not enter icing keywords or set icing Vref
chain.trigger: The accident flight crew did not enter the keywords 'icing' or 'eice'... If the flight crew had made either entry, then AeroData would have provided a Vref of 138 knots

caused_by.evidence: Colgan's approach procedures for setting airspeed bugs did not reinforce awareness of the ref speeds switch position, which created an opportunity for confusion
she did not enter the keywords 'icing' or 'eice,' despite the icing conditions at the time, the deicing equipment in use, the ref speeds switch in the increase position

chain.label: Sterile cockpit violated by extended nonpertinent conversation below 10,000 feet
chain.trigger: the flight crew's failure to adhere to sterile cockpit procedures

caused_by.evidence: task management and prioritization can be affected by fatigue, and some reports have indicated a reduction in leadership behavior with increased fatigue

chain.label: Captain failed to effectively manage the flight, delaying checklists and callouts
chain.trigger: the captain's failure to effectively manage the flight... enabled conversation that delayed checklist completion and conflicted with sterile cockpit procedures

caused_by.evidence: their depth and duration likely contributed to the delayed performance of callouts and checklists

chain.label: Neither pilot monitored decaying airspeed or the rising low-speed cue
chain.trigger: the flight crew's failure to monitor airspeed in relation to the rising position of the low-speed cue

caused_by.evidence: created an environment that impeded timely error detection
if the captain and the first officer had recalled that the switch was set to the increase position, then they should have recognized that the airspeed for the approach needed to increase by 20 knots
The pilots' failure to detect the impending onset of the stick shaker... could be consistent with the known effects of fatigue

chain.label: Stick shaker activated and autopilot disconnected at 131 knots
chain.trigger: At 2216:27.4, the CVR recorded a sound similar to the stick shaker... when the autopilot disengaged, the airplane was at an airspeed of 131 knots

caused_by.evidence: the airspeed was below the minimum approach speed in icing conditions for about 8 seconds before stick shaker activation

chain.label: Captain's untreated weakness in attitude instrument flying and stall/pusher training gaps
chain.trigger: the captain had not established a good foundation of attitude instrument flying skills early in his career and... his continued weaknesses in basic aircraft control and instrument flying were not identified and adequately addressed

chain.label: Captain pulled aft on control column and added only partial power in response to stick shaker
chain.trigger: the captain's inappropriate response to the activation of the stick shaker

caused_by.evidence: the captain responded by applying a 37-pound pull force to the control column... within 1 second of the stick shaker activation
his improper flight control inputs were inconsistent with his training and were instead consistent with startle and confusion
the night and poor visibility conditions at the time precluded the use of external visual cues for reliable attitude reference

chain.label: Wing exceeded stall AOA and aerodynamic stall developed
chain.trigger: the captain's inappropriate aft control column inputs in response to the stick shaker caused the airplane's wing to stall

caused_by.evidence: The airflow over the wing separated as the stall AOA was exceeded, leading to an aerodynamic stall

chain.label: First officer retracted flaps without command, further raising stall speed
chain.trigger: about 7 seconds after the stick shaker activated, the first officer raised the flaps and then told the captain about the action she had just taken

caused_by.evidence: the raising of the flaps, in addition to the vertical loading at the time, increased the stall speed and reduced the lift being produced by the wings at a time when the airplane was already stalled
the absence of standard callouts from the captain impeded the first officer's abilities to coordinate actions to support him

chain.label: Captain overrode three stick pusher activations; airplane rolled and pitched uncontrollably
chain.trigger: the captain did not recognize the stick pusher's action to decrease AOA as a proper step in a stall recovery, and his improper flight control inputs to override the stick pusher exacerbated the situation

caused_by.evidence: the stick pusher activated... the captain applied a 41-pound pull force... roll angle reached 105 degrees right wing down
increased the stall speed and reduced the lift being produced by the wings at a time when the airplane was already stalled
stick pusher training was not consistently provided to Colgan's Q400 pilots

chain.label: Airplane descended steeply and impacted a residence in Clarence Center
chain.trigger: The airplane impacted a single-family home... and a postcrash fire ensued

caused_by.evidence: The airplane's pitch and roll angles had reached about 25 degrees airplane nose down and 100 degrees right wing down, respectively, when the airplane entered a steep descent

chain.label: All 49 aboard and one person on the ground killed
chain.trigger: The 2 pilots, 2 flight attendants, and 45 passengers aboard the airplane were killed, one person on the ground was killed

caused_by.evidence: the airplane was destroyed by impact forces and a postcrash fire... cause of death for the airplane occupants and the ground victim was multiple blunt force trauma
